name: Roccat mice
description: Per-LED lighting of Roccat mice: Kone Aimo and Kone Aimo 16K, Kone Pro, Kone Pro Air (wireless and wired), Kone XP, Burst Core and Burst Pro. Adapted from OpenRGB's Roccat controllers (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The profile (flash) report, DPI and polling rate are never touched; at exit the Kone Pro, Burst and Kone XP go back to their built-in lighting. Held back: Burst Pro Air (1E7D:2CA6, colours through the profile report id) and Kova (1E7D:2CEE, no direct mode, every change rewrites the stored profile). Protocol notes: docs/hardware/roccat-mouse.md.
